name: std::extents<IndexType,Extents...>::dynamic-index

declarations.code:
private:
static constexpr auto /*dynamic-index*/ (rank_type i) noexcept;

intro: Returns the number of dynamic extents below index i. If i <= rank() is false, the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The number of Er with r < i for which Er is a dynamic extent.
